tracks.mission: Split Shift (Marlow Build owns objectives, rules and teams: origin/feature/mission-framework docs/missions/prototypes/split-shift/BEAT.md); this is the layout and its hooks

A.rule: ghost (never seen; scored by the alerted guard's zone)
A.note: Walk 144 m at 1.3 m/s = 111 s + overhear 4-6 s + panel 1.5 s + hack 3 s; waits for the cut before 4A.

B.note: Walk 146 m = 112 s + read 1 s + cut 1 s, plus the hold (the twist: #7 and #1 reach the board in about 70 s).

tracks.exfil_note: Split Shift is an S2-only mission: its exfil is the bridge landing. Not tagged on the space: an exfil tag in S2 breaks the five-file campus run (start-to-exfil skips S3 / S4); the campus exfil stays in S5.
tracks.parity_note: Mission tracks (Marlow), not a validator split: A 122 s vs B 115 s with actions (6%), walks 144 vs 146 m (1%). Both are over the 90 s co-op split cap by design: the teams run apart for the whole section and do not cover each other; the validator split inside it is s2-hack (L1, 40.4 vs 41.5 s).
